_doc: Copy to config/buffer_routing.json (gitignored) and fill in YOUR Buffer org + channel IDs. IDs only, never tokens. One product can route to several pages, but a single video is only ever posted to ONE page (MR19). locked=true -> never routed. plan=free -> 10 scheduled posts per Buffer account (drafts counted).

buffer2.note: optional second Buffer account (free plan = 3 channels each)
